# AusWindowShrouds

> Premium aluminium window shrouds and screens for residential and commercial projects across Australia. Melbourne-based specialists offering custom facade solutions for design appeal, privacy, and thermal efficiency.

AusWindowShrouds is an Australian window shroud and screening supplier. The site showcases product ranges, shares project insights via articles, and lets visitors request quotes for custom installations.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of window shroud products, services, company background, and contact options.
- [Products](/products): Browse the full range of aluminium window shrouds and screens.
- [Latest](/latest): Articles and updates about window shroud projects, trends, and tips.

## Optional

- [Product example](/products/aluminium-window-shrouds): Representative product detail page for aluminium window shrouds.
- [Article example](/latest/welcome-to-our-blog): Representative blog post showcasing project updates and insights.
